# dsh-plugin-finance-data > DSH Agent 的确定性金融算术工具，但比率文本、跨年定投和组合再平衡路径存在可核不一致。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data) - **版本号**：0.3.2（[固定提交 0a10267fa6f8f75da68005406b899894b60dd796](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data/tree/0a10267fa6f8f75da68005406b899894b60dd796)） - **版本日期**：2026-09-11（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 源码确认纯算术工具与 10 类 action；百分数百倍展示、定投默认仅 12 期和再平衡函数未接工具属于明确代码路径问题。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：Agent 在有已核来源/口径的数字上做格式化、收益与风险计算。 - **亮点**：将常见财务算术从模型口算转为确定性工具，并提示数据来源/口径。详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **思考**：四类财务比率在计算层和展示层各乘 100；多年 plan 默认只算 12 期，portfolio 未返回再平衡单。详见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **建议**：统一单位契约并分离最终计算与表格采样，配黄金样本可提高可靠性；修复效果尚未验。详见[Q04](#research-q04)。 采用建议：修复关键路径前不用于真实决策；以 10/100 比率、2 年月投和组合偏离样本验每个 action。详见[Q02](#research-q02)至[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 核心贡献 将常见财务算术从模型口算转为确定性工具，并提示数据来源/口径。详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 关键质疑 四类财务比率在计算层和展示层各乘 100；多年 plan 默认只算 12 期，portfolio 未返回再平衡单。详见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 统一单位契约并分离最终计算与表格采样，配黄金样本可提高可靠性；修复效果尚未验。详见[Q04](#research-q04)。 修复后对所有 action 做单位、期数、边界和黄金样本核对，再到目标宿主复验文本/结构值。 ## 场景与替代办法 Agent 在有已核来源/口径的数字上做格式化、收益与风险计算。 模型自行计算或电子表格；工具可重复，但当前关键输出不可靠。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 条件 | 条件 | 用途 | 缺失时 | | --- | --- | --- | | DSH tools/systemPrompt | Agent 调用 | 无工具入口 | | 已核金融输入 | 正确解释 | 结果无事实根基 | | 黄金样本 | 公式回归 | 错误易扩散 | #### 修复验证 | 步骤 | 输入 | 判据 | | --- | --- | --- | | 比率 | 10/100 | 10% | | 定投 | 两年月投 | 24 期终值 | | 组合 | 60/40 目标与偏离 | 给出买卖金额 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 资源 | 边界 | | --- | --- | --- | | 输入 | 经核口径数字 | 无行情来源 | | 核算 | 黄金样本复核 | 当前三个关键错误 | | 维护 | 单位/期数测试 | 金融输出需严格可靠 | #### 效果 | 项 | 源码支持 | 问题 | | --- | --- | --- | | 比率 | 纯函数 | 展示百倍 | | 定投 | 周期循环 | 默认截断 12 期 | | 组合 | 权重/独立再平衡函数 | 工具未接再平衡 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标：**核实金融计算工具的用途、输出口径与代码/宣传不一致；不给投资建议。 ### Q01 · 工具包实际提供什么？ **研究主题：**场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 插件注册 finance_data Agent 工具和可选金融提示段，纯函数做格式、收益、财务比率、现值/终值、风险、清单、定投、组合、趋势与同业分位数。数学与宿主适配分在 finance.js/index.js，便于离线算术与单元测试。它不提供原始行情、财报、事实核验或投资决策；模型需提供来源、时点、单位与口径。README 中文表列 8 类动作，但工具枚举还有 trend/peer 两类，文档范围滞后。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.zh.md:1-35](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data/blob/0a10267fa6f8f75da68005406b899894b60dd796/README.zh.md#L1-L35) 作者说明确定性计算、8 类动作与薄适配层。
查看原文（35行） ````text # dsh-plugin-finance-data 面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) agent 的**金融数据工具包**：数字格式化、收益计算、估值与盈利比率、时间价值、风险指标，全部确定性计算。模型负责解读，插件负责算术。 ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add dsh-plugin-finance-data ``` 重启 DSH 后，`finance_data` 工具全局注册。 ## 工具 | 动作 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `format` | 数字/货币/百分比格式化，千分位，中文万/亿单位 | | `return` | 简单/对数/年化收益（CAGR 风格） | | `ratio` | PE、PB、ROE、ROA、毛利率、净利率、产权比率 | | `value` | 现值、终值、隐含收益率 | | `risk` | 收益率序列的均值、波动率、最大回撤、历史 VaR(95)、夏普比率 | | `checklist` | 数据质量检查清单（来源、时点、单位、口径） | | `plan` | 定投/复利模拟（终值时间表、通胀调整实际价值） | | `portfolio` | 组合权重、漂移与再平衡指令（买/卖金额） ## 配置 均为可选项，写在组合行的 `config` 里： | 键 | 默认值 | 含义 | | --- | --- | --- | | `personaSection` | `true` | 是否注册金融提示词段 | | `sectionOrder` | `6` | 提示词段顺序（persona 为 0，升序） | ## 设计 ````
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[lib/index.js:12-24](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data/blob/0a10267fa6f8f75da68005406b899894b60dd796/lib/index.js#L12-L24) 引入计算函数并声明 tools/systemPrompt。
查看原文（13行） ```text import z from "@deepseek-ai/schemastery"; import { defineTool } from "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools"; import { analyzeTrend, computeRatio, computeReturn, dataChecklist, formatNumber, peerCompare, portfolioWeights, projectPlan, rebalance, riskMetrics, ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[lib/index.js:53-71](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data/blob/0a10267fa6f8f75da68005406b899894b60dd796/lib/index.js#L53-L71) 工具枚举共 10 类动作。
查看原文（19行） ```text ctx.tools.register(defineTool({ name: "finance_data", description: "Finance-data helper: `format` (number/currency/percent formatting, optional Chinese wan/yi units), `return` (simple, log, and annualized returns), `ratio` (PE, PB, ROE, ROA, gross/net margin, debt-to-equity), `value` (present/future value and implied rate), `risk` (mean, volatility, max drawdown, historical VaR(95), Sharpe from a return series), `checklist` (data-quality checklist), `plan` (DCA/compound projection with inflation adjustment), `portfolio` (portfolio weights, drift and rebalance orders), `trend` (metric time-series level/direction/volatility), `peer` (value vs peer distribution: P10/P50/P90 + percentile rank). Use it whenever the task involves financial figures, returns, valuations, or risk.", parameters: { action: { type: "string", required: true, enum: ["format", "return", "ratio", "value", "risk", "checklist", "plan", "portfolio", "trend", "peer"], description: "Which finance helper to run.", }, value: { type: "number", description: "Number to format (format)." }, decimals: { type: "integer", description: "Decimal places (format)." }, thousands: { type: "boolean", description: "Thousands separators (format)." }, currency: { type: "string", description: "Currency symbol prefix (format)." }, percent: { type: "boolean", description: "Treat value as a fraction and render as percent (format)." }, zh: { type: "boolean", description: "Use Chinese wan/yi units (format)." }, start: { type: "number", description: "Starting value (return)." }, end: { type: "number", description: "Ending value (return)." }, periods: { type: "integer", description: "Number of periods for annualization (return)." }, annualized: { type: "boolean", description: "Compute annualized return (return)." }, ```
#### 缺口 - 未在目标 DSH 调用工具。 **影响：**模型选择、参数补全和界面输出未核。 **进一步探讨：**用受控案例在宿主检验 action 选择和错误处理。 ### Q02 · 比率百分数输出是否准确？ **研究主题：**功能与机制、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 finance.js 的 roe、roa、grossMargin、netMargin 已把除法结果乘 100，返回百分数数值；index.js 的 ratio 分支又把这四类设置 percent=true，formatNumber 再乘 100 并附 %。例如净利润 10、收入 100，计算值为 10，但工具文本格式化成 1000.00%。这是静态代码路径可直接推导的百倍展示错误，且风险是 Agent 可能引用文本而不是原值。PE/PB 等非百分数不走这条错误路径。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[lib/finance.js:10-24](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data/blob/0a10267fa6f8f75da68005406b899894b60dd796/lib/finance.js#L10-L24) percent 格式化对输入再乘 100。
查看原文（15行） ```text export function formatNumber({ value, decimals = 2, thousands = true, currency = "", percent = false, zh = false } = {}) { const v = Number(value); if (!Number.isFinite(v)) throw new Error("finance: value must be a finite number"); let out; if (percent) { out = (v * 100).toFixed(Math.max(0, Math.floor(decimals))) + "%"; } else if (zh && Math.abs(v) >= 1e8) { out = (v / 1e8).toFixed(Math.max(0, Math.floor(decimals))) + "亿"; } else if (zh && Math.abs(v) >= 1e4) { out = (v / 1e4).toFixed(Math.max(0, Math.floor(decimals))) + "万"; } else { out = v.toFixed(Math.max(0, Math.floor(decimals))); if (thousands) out = out.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ","); } return (currency ? currency + out : out); ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[lib/finance.js:43-55](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data/blob/0a10267fa6f8f75da68005406b899894b60dd796/lib/finance.js#L43-L55) 四个比率计算时已乘 100。
查看原文（13行） ```text export function computeRatio({ type = "pe", price, eps, bvps, netIncome, equity, assets, revenue, cogs, debt } = {}) { const ratio = { pe: () => { if (price == null || eps == null || eps === 0) throw new Error("finance: pe needs price and eps (eps != 0)"); return price / eps; }, pb: () => { if (price == null || bvps == null || bvps === 0) throw new Error("finance: pb needs price and bvps (bvps != 0)"); return price / bvps; }, roe: () => { if (netIncome == null || equity == null || equity === 0) throw new Error("finance: roe needs netIncome and equity (equity != 0)"); return (netIncome / equity) * 100; }, roa: () => { if (netIncome == null || assets == null || assets === 0) throw new Error("finance: roa needs netIncome and assets (assets != 0)"); return (netIncome / assets) * 100; }, grossMargin: () => { if (revenue == null || cogs == null || revenue === 0) throw new Error("finance: grossMargin needs revenue and cogs (revenue != 0)"); return ((revenue - cogs) / revenue) * 100; }, netMargin: () => { if (netIncome == null || revenue == null || revenue === 0) throw new Error("finance: netMargin needs netIncome and revenue (revenue != 0)"); return (netIncome / revenue) * 100; }, debtToEquity: () => { if (debt == null || equity == null || equity === 0) throw new Error("finance: debtToEquity needs debt and equity (equity != 0)"); return debt / equity; }, }[type]; if (!ratio) throw new Error("finance: unknown ratio type '" + type + "'"); return { type, value: ratio() }; } ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[lib/index.js:137-145](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data/blob/0a10267fa6f8f75da68005406b899894b60dd796/lib/index.js#L137-L145) ratio 分支对四类再次调用 percent 格式化。 ```text case "ratio": values = computeRatio({ type: args.type, price: args.price, eps: args.eps, bvps: args.bvps, netIncome: args.netIncome, equity: args.equity, assets: args.assets, revenue: args.revenue, cogs: args.cogs, debt: args.debt, }); value = values.value; const isPct = ["roe", "roa", "grossMargin", "netMargin"].includes(args.type); text = values.type + " = " + formatNumber({ value, percent: isPct, decimals: 2, zh: true }); ``` #### 缺口 - 未执行目标工具确认宿主最终展示。 **影响：**已能从代码确定文本计算路径，但实际模型采信程度未知。 **进一步探讨：**用 ROE=10/100 等固定案例验证工具 text/value，并统一比率单位契约。 ### Q03 · 定投和组合动作是否兑现描述？ **研究主题：**工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 plan 的周期数为 years×频率，却用默认 steps=12 截断实际迭代；index.js 调用 projectPlan 时未传 steps。故默认月度定投无论 years=2 或 10，表和 final 只算前 12 期，摘要仍显示用户输入的 years。portfolio 说明称权重、漂移及再平衡买卖指令，finance.js 有 rebalance 函数，但 index.js portfolio case 只调用 portfolioWeights，未把 rebalance 结果交给工具，买卖指令不会出现。这两个接口/文档不一致会直接影响金额和动作建议。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[lib/finance.js:133-171](https://github.com/863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data/blob/0a10267fa6f8f75da68005406b899894b60dd796/lib/finance.js#L133-L171) plan 用 Math.min(periods,steps) 截断并据此算 final。
查看原文（39行） ```text export function projectPlan({ principal = 0, contribution = 0, contributionFrequency = "month", annualRate = 0, years = 1, inflation = 0, steps = 12 } = {}) { const p = Number(principal) || 0; const c = Number(contribution) || 0; const r = Number(annualRate) || 0; const yrs = Math.max(0.1, Number(years) || 0); const inf = Number(inflation) || 0; if (p < 0 || c < 0) throw new Error("finance: principal and contribution must be non-negative"); if (r < -100) throw new Error("finance: annualRate must be >= -100"); const perYear = contributionFrequency === "year" ? 1 : contributionFrequency === "week" ? 52 : contributionFrequency === "quarter" ? 4 : 12; const n = Math.max(1, Math.floor(steps)); const perPeriod = r / (perYear * 100); const periods = Math.max(1, Math.round(yrs * perYear)); const total = Math.min(periods, n); let balance = p; const schedule = []; for (let i = 1; i <= total; i++) { balance = balance * (1 + perPeriod) + c; const nominal = balance; const real = nominal / Math.pow(1 + inf / 100, i / perYear); schedule.push({ period: i, balance: round2(nominal), real: round2(real) }); } const final = balance; const invested = p + c * total; const totalReturn = final - invested; const finalReal = final / Math.pow(1 + inf / 100, total / perYear); const text = [ "# Projection", "", "Principal: " + round2(p) + ", contribution: " + round2(c) + "/" + contributionFrequency + ", annual rate: " + r + "%, years: " + yrs + (inf > 0 ? ", inflation: " + inf + "%" : ""), "", "| Period | Balance | Real (after inflation) |", "|--------|---------|------------------------|", ...schedule.map((s) => "| " + s.period + " | " + s.balance + " | " + s.real + " |"), "", "Invested: " + round2(invested) + ", final: " + round2(final) + ", return: " + round2(totalReturn) + " (" + (invested > 0 ? round2((totalReturn / invested) * 100) : 0) + "%)", "Final real value: " + round2(finalReal), ].join("\n"); return { principal: round2(p), contributionPerPeriod: round2(c), totalContributed: round2(c * total), invested: round2(invested), final: round2(final), finalReal: round2(finalReal), totalReturn: round2(totalReturn), returnPct: invested > 0 ? round2((totalReturn / invested) * 100) : 0, schedule, text }; } ```
